spans.s:
mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Prosperous, happy.
m. (-वः)
1 The deity ŚIVA, the most formidable of the Hindu triad, the destroyer of creation: the adoration of which he is the object, is of a more gloomy nature in general than that of the rest, and he is the particular god of the Tāntrikas or followers of the books called

Tantras.
2

Final emancipation from existence, eternal happiness.
3 A pillar or post to which cattle are tied.
4 An auspicious planetary conjunction.
5 Scripture, the

Vedas.
6
A drug, commonly

Elavāluka.
7
A perfume,

Puṇḍarīya.
8

Bdellium.
9
One of the astronomical periods termed

Yogas.
10

Quicksilver.
11

The penis.
12 The phallic emblem of ŚIVA.
n. (-वं)
1 Happiness, pleasure.
2 Auspiciousness, well being.
3

Water.
4

Sea or fossile salt.
5 Borax.
f. (-वा)
1 The goddess DURGĀ, the wife of Ś

IVA.
2

The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.)
3 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
4 Emblic myrobalan.
5 A shakal.
6 The mother of the twenty-second Jina.
E.
शी to sleep, Uṇādi aff. वन्, on or in whom or which, the universe reposes.

(उ) षिवु r. 4th cl. (सीव्यति)
1 To sew, to stitch.
3 To sow, as seed.

m. (-कः)
A post to which cows or calves are tied.
E.
शिव the same, कन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Propitious, auspicious, making happy.
m. (-रः)
A Jina of the last age.
E.
शिव good fortune, and कर who makes.

m. (-नः)
1 An attendant on Ś

IVA.
2

KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU.
n. (-नं)
Praising or hymning ŚIVA.
E.
शिव ŚIVA, and कीर्त्तन celebrating.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
1 Happy, prosperous.
2 Worshipping ŚIVA.
m. (-तिः)
One of the Jinas of the past age.
E.
शिव auspiciousness, and गति going.

m. (-जः)
The planet MARS.
E.
शिव ŚIVA, घर्म्म perspiration, and ज born.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Propitious, auspicious, conferring happiness or good fortune.
E.
शिव good fortune, कृ to make, aff. खच्.

f. (-शी)
A festival in honour of ŚIVA, on the fourteenth of the dark half of Māgha.
E.
शिव, and चतुर्दशी fourteenth.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
1 Knowing what is good or propitious.
2 Worshipping ŚIVA.
f. (-ज्ञा)
A female devotee of the Śaiva sect.
E.
शिव ŚIVA, and ज्ञा to know, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Propitious, conferring happiness or fortune.
E.
शिव happiness, तातिल् aff.; also शिवतातिक.

n. (-त्तं)
The discus of VIṢṆU.
E.
शिव ŚIVA, and दत्त given.

m. (-रुः)
The Devadaru tree, (Pinus Deodar.)

f. (-का)
One of the Mātṛs or divine mothers.
E.
शिवटूती DURGĀ, and कन् aff.

f. (-ती)
DURGĀ.
E.
शिव ŚIVA, and टूती, from टूत a messenger, fem. aff. ङीष्.

m. (-तुः)
The milk stone, opal or chalcedony.
E.
शिव ŚIVA, and धातु a mineral.

f. (-री)
The holy city Benares.
E.
शिव, and पुरी the city; being sacred to ŚIVA especially.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Dear to or esteemed by ŚIVA.
m. (-यः)
1 The Sesbana grandiflora.
3 Crystal.
f. (-या)
The goddess DURGĀ.
n. (-यं)
The seeds of the Eleocarpus.
E.
शिव, and प्रिय beloved.

m. (-यः)
A goat.
E.
शिवा DURGA, and प्रिय beloved by.

f. (-ल्ली)
The Sesbana grandiflora.
E.
शिव, and मल्ली jasmine.

m. (-सः)
The water of boiled rice or pulse three days old, and undergoing spontaneous fermentation.
E.
शिव ease, and रस juice.

f. (-त्रिः)
A celebrated festival in honour of ŚIVA on the fourteenth of the moon's wane or dark fortnight in Māgha.
E.
शिव, and रात्रि night.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Loved or esteemed by ŚIVA.
m. (-भः)
1 The mango tree.
2 Gigantic swallow wort.
f. (-भा)
The goddess PĀRVATĪ.
E.
शिव ŚIVA, and वल्लभ beloved.

m. (-नः)
A bull.
E.
शिव the deity, and वाहन vehicle.

n. (-जं)
Quicksilver.
E.
शिव ŚIVA, and वीज semen, its supposed origin.

m. (-रः)
1 The Sesbana grandiflora.
2 The moon.
E.
शिव ŚIVA, and शेखर a crest.

n. (-क्षं)
The seed of the Eleocarpus.
E.
शिव ŚIVA, and अक्ष from अक्षि the eye.

f. (-नी)
1 A flower, (Celtis orientalis.)
2 A name of DURGĀ.
E.
शिव the deity, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment.

m. (-तिः)
A dog.
E.
शिवा a shakal, and अराति an enemy.

m. (-यः)
Red Tulasī or basil.
n. (-यं)
1 A cemetery or place where dead bodies are burnt or buried.
2 Any temple dedicated to ŚIVA.
E.
शिव ŚIVA, and आलय abode.

f. (-तिः)
A plant, (Celtis orientalis.)

m. (-विः)
1 A beast of prey.
2 The Bhojpatra or birch tree.
3 A king so named.

f. (-का)
A palanquin, a litter.
E.
शिव nominal verb, to give pleasure or ease, aff. ण्वुल्.

m. (-ष्टः)
A name of ŚIVA: see शिपिविष्ट.

n. (-रं)
1 A camp.
2 A royal camp or residence.
3 A guard or defence for the soldiers.
4 A sort of grain.
E.
शी to sleep or rest, किरच् Uṇādi aff. and वुक् augment.

m. (-थः)
A palanquin, a litter.
E.
शिवी for शिविका the same, and रथ a conveyance.

m. (-वा)
A large snake, the Boa.
E.
शी to sleep, क्वनिप् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-लं)
1 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.)
2 Benzoin or Storax.
E.
शी to sleep, (on the water,) वलच् aff., and the vowel unchanged; also शैवाल, &c.

n. (-नं)
Sewing, stitching.
f. (-नी)
The frenum of the prepuce.
E.
षिव to sew, ल्युट् aff.; also सेवन.
